# Claude of Tanks technical field manual

> Detailed public documentation for the current Claude of Tanks simulation, 240 production-visible procedural vehicles, 33 battlefields, 13 battle modes, Three.js renderer, multiplayer authority, interface, mobile support, Tank Gallery, and Scene Studio.

## Manual

- [Field manual index](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs): Current system overview, build facts, visual evidence, and links to every detailed guide.
- [Your first battle](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/start): Pick a tank, deploy, drive, aim, fire and win your first Claude of Tanks battle, with the game's own keys and rules.
- [Controls and Watch](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/controls): Every Claude of Tanks action with its key, mouse button and gamepad button, the touch controls, and Watch mode's drone, ride along and take control.
- [Game modes](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/modes): Every Claude of Tanks mode with its goal, clock, respawn, sides and rules, and its objectives drawn on the map.
- [Tanks and equipment](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/tanks): The Claude of Tanks fleet by class, battle role, tier and nation, the 14 equipment items and the consumables, smoke and drone every tank can carry.
- [Armour, angling and spotting](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/combat): How Claude of Tanks resolves a hit: penetration over range, effective armour at an angle, ricochets, spaced armour and ERA, modules, crew and fires, and the spotting rules.
- [Battlefields](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/battlefields): Every Claude of Tanks battlefield with its art and landscapes, the random rotation, the gravity worlds, the time of day and the Proving Ground.
- [Multiplayer](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/multiplayer): How to play Claude of Tanks with friends: private rooms by code or invite link, the local network, seats and team sizes, the modes a room plays, and what happens when someone leaves.
- [Sound and radio](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/audio): What Claude of Tanks sounds tell you: your gunner's hit calls, the crew's warnings, crew radio in 13 languages, 18 gun reports and how far they carry, engines and tracks, and the Sound settings.
- [Scene Studio](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/studio): How to film Claude of Tanks in the Scene Studio: open any film on the site as a scene, set the battlefield, time and tanks, place camera shots and effects, and export stills or film.
- [How the game was built](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/build): How a solo developer built Claude of Tanks through typed architecture, procedural assets, deterministic simulation, test gates, performance evidence, and persistent agent collaboration.
- [Simulation and authority](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/simulation): How Claude of Tanks runs a battle: the 60 Hz fixed step, the host's authority over hits and results, what each player is sent, terrain and movement, and how it is verified.
- [Procedural model pipeline](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/models): How Claude of Tanks researches, constructs, articulates, audits, compares, and releases its first-party procedural tank models.
- [Rendering and performance](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/rendering): How Claude of Tanks draws and loads: the renderer, lighting, post-processing, adaptive quality, an isolated boot and battle loading staged behind cover.
- [Bots and tactical AI](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/ai): Technical guide to bot perception, route planning, tactical positioning, aiming, team behavior, survival, and deterministic verification in Claude of Tanks.
- [Filming the media](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/docs/filming): How the Claude of Tanks site takes, portraits and films were shot in Scene Studio: a motion search, schematic previz, engine reviews and their fixes, supersampled 4K finals, stills and generated sound.

## Related

- [Full public agent reference](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/llms-full.txt): Terminology, source hierarchy, current facts, limitations, policy, and citation guidance.
- [Tank Gallery](https://cot.kevinliu.studio/gallery): Interactive vehicle inspection.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Kevin-Liu-01/Claude-of-Tanks): Architecture, implementation, tests, and policies.
